propositions: committed locks freeze transitive dependencies, causing any published advisory against the pinned version to fail gating on all in-flight changes regardless of whether those changes touched the dependency map

the current single gating lane blocks all changes equally on an advisory, punishing authors of unrelated changes and distributing diagnostic load across multiple work streams when advisory triage belongs to the lock owner

uv constraint-dependencies can only narrow constraints and returns UNSATISFIABLE as expected output, not proof the upgrade is impossible, and override-dependencies is the correct mechanism to replace an offending requirement
pip-audit recheck logic only retries database-unreachable failures, making recheck impossible on real findings and creating the most time-wasting property for blocked authors
the response to an outstanding advisory on main must fail visibly with escalation, while blocking Gerrit verify only for changes that touch the dependency map itself
